hypothesis: Above-zero NFCI denotes tighter-than-average U.S. financial conditions and predicts adverse crypto risk appetite; short the equal-weight crypto basket only after a conservative 7-day availability lag.

signal.raw_macro_missing_policy: no imputation/no carry-forward of missing source observations
signal.state_persistence: after the 7-day lag, the latest actually observed weekly state remains in force until the next lagged observed release

rationale: Zero is the NFCI's economically natural boundary between tighter- and looser-than-average financial conditions, not a sample-fitted quantile. Seven calendar days is deliberately conservative for weekly macro availability and prevents same-observation-date use. No sign flip or rescue is permitted if the ex-ante direction fails.
gate: Aggregate and every chronological fold must have return > 0 and daily PF > 1 under base costs; aggregate severe and supersevere must each have return > 0 and daily PF > 1; gross cap and invariants must pass.
